segments.name: MRAM technology
segments.description: Develops and sells MRAM-based memory products, licenses and royalties, and foundry services to OEMs and ODMs in industrial, medical, automotive, aerospace and data center markets.
segments.evidence: The Company's MRAM technology solutions are sold as products and services through MRAM-based products, licenses and royalties of MRAM and magnetic sensor technology and backend foundry and design services.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by distributors, contract manufacturers and direct customers for MRAM products, licenses, royalties and foundry services.
revenueModel.evidence: Although we actually sell the products to, and are paid by, the distributors and contract manufacturers, we refer to the end customer as our customer.
